decision: Independent collision candidate retained on work branch for parent judgment; do not claim the standalone >=0.5ms gate passed. Both controls were slower, but improvement vs the faster control is 0.468464ms. Previously accepted stationary-publication work remains separate and is not counted as collision gain. Main unchanged.
fixture_repairs: Initial run failed on wrong isolated extension path and malformed numeric-update fixture (friendly source/repeat delay). Corrected test setup; no kernel semantic fix was needed. Rerun passed.
equivalence: A1/B/A2 before and after full canonical kernel/game states identical except RNG seed metadata and derived kernel_hash; RNG state and all event counts identical. Differential cached/uncached test compares actual motion lease state, ordered feedback, HP and RNG across 12 scenarios and 4 weapon kinds.
algorithm: Cache first forward intersection distance for a stationary target at birth, refresh on actor geometry revision. Far steps compare lease progress against conservative lower gate. At contact preserve exact original hull_contact predicate and active-order settlement. Misses/degenerate rays and dynamic targets retain segment checks. No new projectile scan or deadline queue.
ownership: Actor owns hull revision and stationary flag; Flight owns derived ray/contact distance; existing MotionLease owns actual motion, existing Handle owns target generation. Public fixed_screen fields remain for legacy handoff. Numeric-only configuration changes do not invalidate unchanged geometry; geometric publication/configuration and entry/static transitions do.
scope: Same complete held-health 15-enemy scene, true speed1, 60Hz battle, uncapped/VSync0, GPU contacts and persistent projectiles on, stat cache on, saves off. Each run 480 native steps / 8 game seconds. Separate baseline and candidate DLLs, actual loaded path and SHA recorded per run.
remaining: Under-10ms target remains unmet. No natural-save/long-run claim. Polygon pass counts are not time savings; total native kernel time is not a removable collision budget. No standalone gain claimed above the 0.5ms gate.
